lines: How does coffee keep you awake?
Plot twist... it doesn't give you any energy at all!
All day long, a sleepy chemical builds up in your brain, telling you to rest.
Caffeine looks just like it, so it steals its parking spots and blocks the message!
But the sleepy stuff keeps piling up... so when the caffeine wears off, crash!
It hangs around for hours, so have your last coffee about eight hours before bed.
